distinguishCodeFromListened: Everything below marked 'code' is authored table/state read from source. Everything marked 'rendered-analysis' is an OfflineAudioContext WAV render plus numeric analysis captured on 2026-08-12. NOTHING below is a human-listened validation, and no current aural validation is claimed.

cueAndMoodOwnership_code.perBeatMoodTable: main/src/story/storyScore.ts :: MOODS — one entry per StoryBeat through ch9-hearth. ch9-settle: chord [0,4,7,10,14], tempo 82, triangle, baseline 0.38. ch9-hearth: chord [0,4,7,10,14], progression [[0,4,7,10],[7,10,14],[0,7,12]], melody density 0.26, tempo 56, triangle, pad 0.17, sub 0.08, ost 0.024, riser 0.05, baseline 0.28.
cueAndMoodOwnership_code.chapter10Variants: CH10_MOODS + CH10_VARIANT_BEAT, 10 variants over 3 beats: ch10-cold owns cold-settled / fault-ledger / refused; ch10-ask owns crossing-back / relay-ask / relay-answer / bearing-claimed; ch10-transit owns transit-hold / seam-ebb / station-resolved. Variant selection is a pure resolver over durable milestones, so a mid-transit reload re-establishes the same variant.
cueAndMoodOwnership_code.authoredCensus: storyScore.ts exposes a read-only inventory of every authored mood entry (MOODS plus ch7 reconstruction/boarding variants plus ch10 variants); the file's own comment cites a 62-entry authored census.
cueAndMoodOwnership_code.composedTimelineBeats: COMPOSED_TIMELINE_BEATS = descent, ch1-lift, a1-ramp, a2-awakening, a3-dawn, a4-exhale, ch5-maw. Nothing in ch6–ch10 is a composed timeline.
cueAndMoodOwnership_code.hitAnchors: STORY_HIT_ANCHORS maps anchor ids to owning beats; anchorTempo() throws if an anchor's beat has no MOODS entry. ch10 anchors observed in code: anc.ch10.bearing-claimed, anc.ch10.threshold-handback.
cueAndMoodOwnership_code.intensityControl: setScoreIntensity is driven from beat entry/completion: a4-exhale entry sets 0.04; the ch4 refusal commit sets 0.

motifs_code.ch10TonicChain: TONIC_CHAIN 'ch10' covers ch10-cold/ch10-ask/ch10-transit at mode 'absolute', offset 0 — the literal MOODS roots untransposed. Frozen comment: the station is deliberately the first destination the score refuses a tonal home.
motifs_code.voicingPolicy: All three ch10 beats resolve voicingPolicy 'literal'. ch10 variant subtractions render literal under the ch10 beat rule (the ch4-comply law).
motifs_code.carrier: CH10_CARRIER_DEGREE — a suspended-fourth/eleventh colour (degree 17, second voice doubling at 29) that is scale-legal in both home modes and a chord tone of neither. Born as the unreleased final tone of the relay-answer figure; present in every variant from relay-answer through station-resolved.
motifs_code.institutionalReuses: Three reuses, no inventions: the square wave (institution since ch1), the carrier pitch, and machine time (REGULATION figures carry uniform velocity, zero drop probability, fixed articulation against the world's seeded variation).
motifs_code.crossChapterDNA: cold-settled = ch9-hearth DNA with the melody cut and the floor dropped a whole step. crossing-back = ch8-crossing DNA at 68 BPM, mirrored, colder, dropped step riding in the sub. transit-hold = ch8 flight DNA with the carrier held. station-resolved quotes the hearth's closing cell once.

silenceAndSubtraction_code.refused: melody voice does not return for the remainder of ch10-cold; the beat exits quiet. Refusal as subtraction.
silenceAndSubtraction_code.seam-ebb: ost 0, pattern reduced to a single downbeat; percussion and ostinato ebb to zero leaving pad, sub and carrier. Acknowledgment by subtraction.
silenceAndSubtraction_code.station-resolved: ost 0 retained (the ostinato the seam ebbed away does NOT return); pad 0.17 / sub 0.10 sit strictly under a4-exhale's 0.18 / 0.10 on the steady window — the destination may not out-measure the awakening. No mediant, no braam, no lead entrance.
silenceAndSubtraction_code.bearing-claimed: nothing anticipates the claim; the pad re-voices around the carrier. A build would convert the rite into a timer.

transitions_code.ch9-hearth to ch10-cold: same home over the wrong floor; a whole step, not a semitone (the semitone is the shipped dread interval and this chapter has no antagonist).
transitions_code.relay-ask to relay-answer: same level, same timbre family, same register, zero dynamic accent; the [0,7] cell keeps sounding straight through the variant boundary. ONE anchor drives both K8's paint-begin and the answer figure's audio onset in the same frame — a deliberate simultaneity, not a tuned offset.
transitions_code.beatEntryHook: setScoreBeat retunes the whole instrument to the beat's mood; a moodOverride can be installed and cleared per beat and is dropped on reset.
transitions_code.handback: the ch10-transit threshold hand-back clears the work order and the guided objective and completes chapter 10; no score cue literal was located at that point beyond the anchor note.

stationSidecarAudio_code.finding: NO audio is wired on the station page. A grep for musicDirector / setScoreMood / playSfx / audio across main/src/components/spaceStation returned only two comment hits. SpaceStationLighting.tsx explicitly says its THRESHOLD_FADE_SECONDS and LOW_LINE timing constants exist so that 'a future station-audio packet inherits them by reference, never by transcription.' The station visit and the return/install currently have no authored cue, mood, or motif ownership.

dateAndSourceLimitations: All rendered audio evidence in range is dated 2026-08-12 and belongs to the 2026-08-11 ch10 run. It is 25 days stale as of 2026-09-06.

It is score-only offline render analysis, not a combined music+SFX render. The later 2026-09-04 audio-10x run's evidence law (README.md) explicitly states 'Combined renders only. A score-only render cannot prove or disprove a mix complaint.' — so the ch10 baseline does not satisfy the current standard.
It covers ch10 beats only. There is no rendered evidence for ch4 arrival/audit/comply/defy, ch5–ch9, the station sidecar, or the return/install.

No human-listened evidence exists for any of it. The 2026-09-04 run's taste gate is an owner audition of A/B excerpts per stage over main/src/audio/soak/excerpts.ts; no record of that audition for this range was found.
